title: A book from a run of spreads
description: Splitting the pages, the order and continuing the run, all in one process.

blocks.text: Hundreds of shots become a book only after rotating, splitting and checking the sequence.

quote.text: During my trial period, before purchasing, I scanned an entire book and when I came back the next day to edit, the entire project was gone. Hours of work had evaporated.

blocks.text: After every spread, show the two pages it produced, mark the last frame that was saved and allow one fragment to be reshot. Open an overview before export.
A blank or repeated page has to be noticeable before the final assembly.
